description_en: Queries split enterprise monthly bill data based on specified split dimensions and returns the results as download links
description_zh: 通过调用本接口可以根据指定的拆分维度查询拆分版企业月账单数据，结果将以下载链接的形式返回
name: MonthBillSplitGet

parameters.help_en:
The billing month.

Format: yyyyMM.
Either the batch number or the billing month is required
parameters.help_zh:
出账月份。

格式要求：yyyyMM。
批次号与出账月份二选一必填
parameters.name: bill_month

parameters.help_en:
The batch number. 

Format: yyyyMMdd.

Either the batch number or the billing month is required
parameters.help_zh:
批次号 

格式要求：yyyyMMdd。

批次号与出账月份二选一必填
parameters.name: bill_batch

parameters.help_en: The list of keys for the bill split dimension
parameters.name: bill_split_key_list

parameters.help_en:
The enterprise access token.

This is a required header parameter for HTTP calls. For information about how to obtain the token, refer to Enterprise access token (https://openapi.alibtrip.com/doc/toDocDetail?spm=openapi-amp.newDocPublishment.0.0.5f19281fIKbnyi&docId=3769985).

You can use corp_token=value in the request URL as an alternative
parameters.help_zh:
企业访问凭证。

是 HTTP 调用方式的 header 必填参数之一，获取方式请参见：企业访问凭证 (https://openapi.alibtrip.com/doc/toDocDetail?spm=openapi-amp.newDocPublishment.0.0.5f19281fIKbnyi&docId=3769985)。

可以在请求地址中使用corp_token=value 替代
parameters.name: x_acs_btrip_so_corp_token

bill_split_key.description_en: The key of the bill split dimension

end_date.description_en:
The end date of the billing period.
Format: yyyy-MM-dd
end_date.description_zh:
账期结束时间。
时间格式：yyyy-MM-dd

start_date.description_en:
The start date of the billing period.
Format: yyyy-MM-dd
start_date.description_zh:
账期开始时间。
时间格式：yyyy-MM-dd

url.description_en:
The download link for the bill data. Retrieve the data by using HttpClient and parse it in GBK encoding.
The data is in JSON format.
The link is valid for 5 minutes.
For object descriptions, refer to Alibaba Business Travel bill object overview (https://openapi.alibtrip.com/doc/toDocDetail?docId=5037134)
url.description_zh:
账单数据下载链接，通过 HttpClient 获取，并以 GBK 格式解析。
数据为 JSON 格式。
链接有效期为 5 分钟。
对象说明可参见：阿里商旅账单对象概览 (https://openapi.alibtrip.com/doc/toDocDetail?docId=5037134)

requestId.description_en: The unique identifier of the request

success.description_en: Indicates whether the request was successful

traceId.description_en: The global trace identifier of the request, typically used for troubleshooting
traceId.description_zh: 跟踪请求全局的标识符，通常用于问题排查定位
